KeysToEntries.Armor.RedMountains.Helmet.Description: No one remembers which Dwarf first put a candle on their head, but generations of miners can thank them. Emits light without a torch.
KeysToEntries.Armor.RedMountains.Helmet.Name: Miner’s Helmet
KeysToEntries.Armor.RedMountains.Starting.Torso.Descri: Simple cloth and wool clothes for the reclusive realm of the Red Mountains Dwarves.
KeysToEntries.Armor.RedMountains.Starting.Torso.Name: Red Mountains Outfit
KeysToEntries.Armor.SouthernmostFireProof.Helmet.Descr: Worn by Dwarves of the The Coastal Mountains, this helmet’s prominent feature is for style more than piercing.
KeysToEntries.Armor.SouthernmostFireProof.Helmet.Name: Spiked Helmet
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Helmet.Description: With two flaps up, this hat makes a statement.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Helmet.Name: Trapper Hat
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Shield.Broken.Description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Shield.Broken.Name: Broken Ornamental Shield
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Shield.Descriptio: This strong metal shield bears the patterns of a long dead line of Dwarf craftsmen.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Stunning.Shield.Name: Ornamental Shield
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Helmet.Description: Worn by heavy infantry troops known to charge enemy lines with their bare hands and chests.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Helmet.Name: Crested Helmet
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Shield.Broken.Description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Shield.Broken.Name: Broken Ram’s Head Shield
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Shield.Description: An ostentatious design meant to cause fear and chaos on the battlefield.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Taunting.Shield.Name: Ram’s Head Shield
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Helmet.Description: Some forms of Dwarven style are based on a dare. At least this dare came with a herioc feat.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Helmet.Name: Wolf Skin Hat
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Shield.Broken.Descriptio: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Shield.Broken.Name: Broken Heirloom Shield
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Shield.Description: A strong iron shield of a lost design.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Wonderful.Shield.Name: Heirloom Shield
KeysToEntries.ArmorDataTable.DEV_RingOfPower.Descripti: Dev only. Makes you invulnerable to mortal wounds and invisible to enemies.
KeysToEntries.ArmorDataTable.UNSHIPPABLE_BootsOfDebugS: With fur. Comfy and super fast.
KeysToEntries.Brews.Defensive_Brew.Description: A draught of this ale and the drinker’s liquid courage makes them much harder to injure. Increases all Damage Resistances.
KeysToEntries.Brews.OrcMedicineBrew_Brew.Description: A burning liquid that goes down with a hot fierce glow. Temporarily raises Stamina and Power but leaves the drinker hurt and tired.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.BangersAndMash.Description: Stuff meat into a thin, tube-like skin. Sear. Meanwhile boil and mash Potatoes. Serve together to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Cranachan.Description: Smash then heat Oats. Stir in Milk until creamy. Layer fruit and honey on the top. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Dough.Description: Mixed and rolled oat dough can be baked into many meals and rations.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.DriedFruit.Description: Chopped, dehydrated fruit in bite-sized pieces. Eat while travelling to restore some health.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.EreborStripSteak.Description: Grill seasoned Meat. Hold your thumb and pointer finger together and touch the palm of your hand. It's ready when the steak feels that firm. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.EveningAle.Description: After a hard days work, this Ale refreshes. Drink with a song and your dreams that night will inspire you for the next day. Refills some energy.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.EveningAle.Name: Evening Ale
KeysToEntries.Consumable.HarshFlower.Description: A harsh weed, this flower is the base of Orc Medicine.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.HealingFlower.Description: A healing flower known to Men as kingsfoil.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.HelmFriedMeatandChips.Descrip: Thinly slice Mountain Potato into rounds. Heat an unoccupied helmet over a flame until sizzling. Fry until crisp. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.MashedPotatoes.Description: Boil potatoes until soft, drain. Whisk in Oat Milk until creamy. Serve hot to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.MeatPie.Description: Fry Sunions until soft, then add Meat until browned. Fill pie crust and bake until golden. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.MushroomPie.Description: Saute Mushrooms then fill pie crust. Bake until golden. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.OatMilk.Description: A fortifying drink and cooking ingredient made from Khuzdul Oats.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.RommegrotPudding.Description: Whip Milk into thick cream then heat until sour. Boil with Honey and Mint then simmer, whisking often. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Scones.Description: Add Milk and Chives into Dough, then fold into triangles and bake. Eat right out of the oven to avoid them drying out. Restores health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.ShireBreakfast.Description: Grill Meat until crispy, serve with hot beans and fried Eggs. Eat to restore health and food, whether its your first, second or third breakfast for the day.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.SmashedCurry.Description: Roast White Beans over a grill then smash with spices until creamy. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Tagine.Description: Richly season Meat and Mushrooms then slow simmer until tender. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.VeggieSkewers.Description: Thread Mushrooms and Sunions onto a stick then rotate over an open flame. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.AntiDarkness.Descriptio: Yeasty and refreshing, this Ale gives the drinker an inner light. Prevents and cures the despair of shadow and darkness from taking hold.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.AntiDarkness.Name: Dawnbreak Pale Ale
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Antidote.Description: This crisp and sour craft brew helps cleanse the drinker head to toe. Both prevents and cures poison.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Antidote.Name: Scour Pilsner
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Health.Description: An Elven cordial distilled with Elbereth’s Blessing. Greatly restores Health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Health.Name: Miruvor
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Stamina.Description: This hoppy ale gives the drinker the "hops." Raises Max Stamina and Stamina Regeneration.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Brew.Stamina.Name: Hopgoblet Lager
KeysToEntries.Consumables.CaveHoney.Description: Sweet and sticky, a treat in the mountains.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Cheese.Description: Pocket-sized cheese wheels. Take with you to restore a little health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Chives.Description: A mild garnish that adds a pleasant flavor to meals.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Cookies.Description: Cookies with fruit and oat. Do not share if a Dwarf complains about fruit in a cookie. Eat while travelling to restore a lot of health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Cram.Description: A biscuitish ration that keeps good and serves an uninteresting chewing exercise. Restores a lot of health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Cram.Name: Cram
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Cranberries.Description: A tart berry that sweetly kisses then bludgeons the mouth.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DeepHash.Description: Slice Deep Mushrooms and stir fry over open flame with fresh Eggs. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DeepMushroom.Description: Mushrooms found only in the Darkest Deeps of Khazad-dûm.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DriedMeat.Description: Smoked, dried Meat. Eat while travelling to restore a little health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DwarfOat.Description: A once carefully cultivated grain now wild and flourishing.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Eggs.Description: A box without hinges, key or lid. Yet golden treasure inside is hid.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.ElvenSecretIngredient.Descri: A blessing of mysterious Elvish nature. A cook must have this blessing to execute on several ale, meal and ration recipes.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Fennel.Description: A delicious aromatic oft farmed from seed
KeysToEntries.Consumables.FireRoastedStew.Description: Brine Meat with Salt. Brown veggies. Simmer together until the smell fills your base. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.FruitPie.Description: Fill Dough with sliced Grabapples and bake. Whip milk into a cream topping. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.FruitSalad.Description: Heat sliced Grabapples over a fire then mix with Cranberries and Honey. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Grabapple.Description: Fruit that favors the light. Pleasingly bitter when eaten raw, cooked, or dried.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Honeycakes.Description: Baked and topped with Honey, a speciality of the Beornings. Eat while travelling to restore some health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.IceCabbage.Description: A leafy plant that adds a satisfying crunch to dishes.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Journeybread.Description: A fruity loaf that stays fresh. Take with you to restore a lot of health while travelling.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.KingsFingers.Description: Whisk together Eggs, Honey and Oats then crisp in a skillet. Roll and eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.KingsOmlette.Description: Fry eggs in a pan, serve hot. This simple breakfast fit for a king restores health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Lembas.Description: Elvish waybread. One cake will keep a traveller on his feet for a day of long labour, fully refilling health and energy.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MealBuff.Breakfast.Descripti: Eat in the morning to reduce Energy cost.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MealBuff.Dinner.Description: Eat in the evening to boost Restoration strength.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MealBuff.Lunch.Description: Eat at mid-day to regenerate Health over time.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Meat.Description: A chunk of meat, endless preparation possibilities.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MeatSkewers.Description: Spread Honey over Meat then grill until carmelized. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MeatStew.Description: Saute and then simmer Meat and Cabbage. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MilledOats.Description: Crushed Khuzdul Oats, suitable for cooking and baking.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MountainPotato.Description: These potatoes grow large like boulders.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Mushroom.Description: A staple ingredient in many a ration or meal.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MushroomScramble.Description: Slice Mushrooms and scramble with Eggs over an open flame. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.MushroomStew.Description: Stew Mushrooms over an open flame until tender and aromatic. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.NanasCasserole.Description: Mix and cook Eggs, Potato and herbs together. This nostalgic favorite restores health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.OvernightBowl.Description: Simmer Milled Oats and fruit until creamy. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Parsnips.Description: A hearty, pungent root for mashing or tea-topping.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Pasties.Description: Golden, savory hand pies. Eat while travelling to restore a lot of health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.PoisonMushroom.Description: A dangerous fungi—if one isn’t careful.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RareMushroom.Description: A mushroom rarely, if ever, found.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RefreshingSalad.Description: Chop Cabbage into bowl, then mix with foraged flowers and fruit. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RoastedCranberries.Descripti: Roast Cranberries over an open fire. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RoastedFruit.Description: Roast Cranberries and Grabapples over an open fire. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RoastedParsnips.Description: Roast whole Parsnips in a Cave Honey glaze over an open fire. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.RoastMeat.Description: Roast a chop of Meat over an open fire. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.SaltedMeat.Description: Dehydrated strips of Meat. Eat while travelling to restore some health.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Spices.Descriptions: Ancient spices of a nutty, smokey savor.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.StuffedMushrooms.Description: Fill Mushrooms with Cranberries and Sunions then cook over an open fire. Eat to restore health and food.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Sunion.Description: A large, spicy-sweet bulb that grows near spots of light.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.TeaFlower.Description: A blossom that brews into a rich, energizing tea.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Thyme.Description: A savory herb for flavoring meat.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.WhiteBeans.Descriptions: A pale bean of great breakfast potential.
KeysToEntries.Container.Brewskin.Description: A small personal skin for carrying any brew or ale.
KeysToEntries.Container.Brewskin.Name: Brewskin
KeysToEntries.Container.Keg.Description: This keg, a marvel of Dwarven engineering, effortlessly transports ale during travel, leaving you oblivious to its weighty presence. Only one Masterwork can be carried at a time.
KeysToEntries.Container.Keg.Name: Wanderkeg
KeysToEntries.Container.Mug.Description: A simple vessel to how a favourite brew or ale.
KeysToEntries.Container.Mug.Name: Mug

KeysToEntries.Armor.NogrodBlack.Gloves.Name: Nogrod Gauntlets Masharuz
KeysToEntries.Armor.NogrodBlack.Gloves.Description: Plate metal gauntlets that increase attack strength but causes more vulnerability. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

KeysToEntries.Armor.NogrodBlack.Torso.Description: Known for their weapon making not their armor, this damasked plate increases the power of a Dwarf’s attack, yet leaves them vulnerable to the attacks of others. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NogrodWhite.Gloves.Name: Nogrod Gauntlets Shayar

KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Consumables.RohanMeal.Name: Rohan Yerêg Stew
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Consumables.RohanMeal.Descript: Wrap meat and other ingredients in the wet leaves of perennial ryegrass, then use the traditional Rohan method of slow roasting over the coals of a long burning fire.
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Weapons.Spear.Rohan.Name: Rohirrim Spear
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Consumables.Brew.RohanBrew.Des: A rare, coveted recipe of brew from Rohan, made by smoking honey over a grass-fed fire then fermenting the results. Raises Max Stamina and Increases Damage Resistance.
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Weapons.Spear.Rohan.Descriptio: Inspired by the long-reached weapons used by the cavalry of Rohan, used by the Yerêg Guard.  Good for rapid single target attacks. Charge for a heavy forward stab.
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Boots.Name: Rohan Boots
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Boots.Description: Ceremonial boots used by the Yerêg Guard, a small force of Dwarves lent to King Éomer by the Lord of the Glittering Caves as a sign of friendship.
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Gloves.Name: Rohan Gauntlets
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Gloves.Description: Ceremonial gloves used by the Yerêg Guard, a small force of Dwarves lent to King Éomer by the Lord of the Glittering Caves as a sign of friendship.
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Helmet.Name: Rohan Helmet

KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Torso.Name: Rohan Armor
KeysToEntries.RohanPack.Armor.Shield.Name: Rohirrim Shield

KeysToEntries.HolidayPack.Consumables.Cookies.Name: Yule Fruit Crust-cake
KeysToEntries.HolidayPack.Consumables.Meal.Description: Follow hand-written instructions from the Shire to cook, bake and prepare this magnificent celebration feast.
KeysToEntries.HolidayPack.Consumables.Brew.HolidayBrew: A rich, spiced, aromatic brew of fermented apples served at Yule-tide or other cozy gatherings. Reduces the effect of Cold and lowers the Energy Costs.

KeysToEntries.OrcHunterPack.Consumables.Brew.Descripti: An bitter ale with a potent but short-lived effect that enhances a Dwarf’s vision in poor lighting. Best drunk from an brewskin during the hunt, allowing Orc Hunters to forgo any light that might alert the evil they stalk.
KeysToEntries.Cosmetics.LordOfMoria.Torso.Name: Lord's Armor

KeysToEntries.BeornPack.Consumables.BeornMeal.Descript: Tradition is to always cook two portions even if alone. Heap leftover roasts, rations and baked goods on a plate to celebrate the hospitality of Beorn. Shh don’t tell the Dwarves that he did not eat meat.
KeysToEntries.Items.Trophy.TrollHide.Name: Troll Hide
KeysToEntries.Items.Trophy.TrollHide.Description: Skin of a large Troll that can be used for building furniture.
KeysToEntries.Items.Trophy.OrcSkull.Name: Rukhus Skull
KeysToEntries.Items.Trophy.OrcSkull.Description: Collected from a fallen Orc, Goblin or Uruk to use in building a decorative trophy.

KeysToEntries.Items.Items.TrollHide.Name: Troll Hide
KeysToEntries.Items.Items.TrollHide.Description: Large section of troll skin, treated for use.

KeysToEntries.EntPack.Consumables.Brew.EntBrew.Descrip: Steeping the flowers of Entwood brews this draught. Increases Damage Reduction.

KeysToEntries.Farming.FungalTree.Name: Ubâsam Tree
KeysToEntries.OrcHunter.Armor.Helmet.Name: Orc Hunter’s Galea
KeysToEntries.OrcHunter.Armor.Helmet.Description: When the Dwarvish <Inventory.Regular.White>Ukhnashûn</> forgo stealth, this helmet strikes fear in the evil they stalk.
KeysToEntries.OrcHunter.Armor.Torso.Name: Orc Hunter’s Mantle

KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Helmet.Name: Beorning Chamber Hat

KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Torso.Name: Beorning Coat

KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Gloves.Name: Beorning Cuffs
KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Gloves.Description: Fur lined shirt with sleeves and cuffs inspired by Beorn’s lodge.
KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Boots.Name: Beorning Slippers
KeysToEntries.Beorn.Armor.Boots.Description: Soft boots meant for comfort on cold nights by the hearth.
KeysToEntries.Items.RedhornPumice.Name: Pumice
KeysToEntries.Items.RedhornPumice.Description: Light stone formed in deep, high pressure pockets. Prized by craftsmen for polishing silver to a mirror shine.
KeysToEntries.Item.PolishedMithril.Name: Mirrored Silver
KeysToEntries.Item.PolishedMithril.Description: Silver worked to mirror perfection by master craftsmen. Reflects not just light, but the skill of its maker.
KeysToEntries.Runes.AntiHeal.Prefix.Name: Wounding
KeysToEntries.Runes.AntiHeal.Name: Brizhûn
KeysToEntries.Runes.AntiHeal.Description: Wounds Orcs such that prevents them from healing on their own.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Artisan.Name: Artisan's Topper
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Artisan.Description: An ornate cap bearing the symbols of Gondor's master crafters. Grants the wearer knowledge of fine metalwork and decorative arts.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Blacksmith.Name: Blacksmith's Caul
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Blacksmith.Description: A practical leather cap worn by battlefield smiths of the Gundabad expedition. Imbued with the knowledge of urgent repairs and weapons forging learned in the heat of siege warfare.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Brewer.Name: Brewmaster's Casque
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Brewer.Description: A practical cap worn by the Glittering Cave's finest brewers. Imbues the wearer with knowledge of ales, meads, and the art of fermentation.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Builder.Name: Builder's Kettle
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Builder.Description: A sturdy cap worn by the master builders reconstructing Minas Tirith. Grants expertise in stonework and architectural planning.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Cook.Name: Cook's Toque
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Cook.Description: A simple white cap favored by the cooks of the Ered Luin. Bestows knowledge of hearty mountain fare and coastal cuisine.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Gatherer.Name: Salvager's Ghillie
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Gatherer.Description: A leaf-green hood inspired by the Woodland Elves. Cosmetic only.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Grocer.Name: Grocer's Hood
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Grocer.Description: A cheerful cap worn by Hobbit grocers throughout the Shire. Provides knowledge of the finest produce and fair trading practices.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Guard.Name: Guard's Helm
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Guard.Description: A battle-worn helm from the Gundabad siege lines. Cosmetic only.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Mason.Name: Mason's Hat
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Mason.Description: A dust-covered cap worn by Blue Mountain stoneworkers. Bestows mastery over stonecutting and precise chiselling.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Metalworker.Name: Metalworker's Slouch
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Metalworker.Description: A practical cap worn by the smiths rebuilding Arnor. Grants skill in basic metalworking.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Miner.Name: Advanced Miner's Helm
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Miner.Description: A sturdy helm devised by the Red Mountain Dwarves after discovering the True-Quartz of Moria. Provides expertise in ore extraction and tunnel safety.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Researcher.Name: Scholar's Cap
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Researcher.Description: An elegant cap worn by the learned of Rivendell, at least that is what the Trader said. Joke or not, it imbues the wearer with ancient knowledge and research methods.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Tailor.Name: [cut] Tailor's Hat
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Tinker.Name: Tinker's Topper
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Tinker.Description: A well-worn cap favored by traveling Tinkers. Bestows the ability to see how something was crafted and unmake it.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CarvedMuralSections.D: Masterfully carved stone panels depicting the ancient glory of Khazad-dûm. Sought after by distant kingdoms to grace their halls with dwarven artistry.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.GoldSilverFiligree.De: Delicate threads of gold and silver woven into intricate patterns. Used by master craftsmen to transform simple goods into works of precious metal art.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.RunicHearthstones.Des: Ancient Dwarven runes carved into stone bricks that radiate warmth without flame. A blessing for any hearth during the long winter months.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BuildingHouseingTools: Precisely forged tools that make light work of stone and timber. No construction project is complete without Dwarven craftsmanship.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.OrnateMetalwork.Name: Decorative Metalwork
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.OrnateMetalwork.Descr: Elaborate metalwork wrought with Dwarven skill and artistry. Transforms any dwelling from humble shelter to noble residence.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ArnorBrew.Name: Northern Ale Barrels
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ArnorBrew.Description: Barrels of strong brew crafted specifically for the hardy men rebuilding Arnor. A bulk export that warms spirits and strengthens resolve through cold northern nights.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.SilverCoins.Name: Silver Coins
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.SilverCoins.Descripti: Freshly minted silver coins ready to be used as currency. Bearing the symbols and marks desired by the distant lands that ordered them.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CrystalLamps.Name: Crystal Lamps
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CrystalLamps.Descript: Crystalline lamps that glow with their own inner fire, requiring no oil or wick. A marvel of ancient Dwarven knowledge restored.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MirroredGlass.Name: Engraved Mirrors
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MirroredGlass.Descrip: Mastercrafted mirrors made from Mirrored Silver. Used for decoration or agricultural uses.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CrossbowLot.Name: Crossbow Arsenal
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CrossbowLot.Descripti: A bulk shipment of precision crossbows forged for distant armies. Each weapon bears the hallmark of Dwarven engineering and deadly accuracy.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DwarvenArrowheads.Des: Razor-sharp points forged in bulk for fletchers across Middle-earth. No arrow flies truer than one tipped with Dwarven steel
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MechanicalToys.Name: Dwarven Toys
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MechanicalToys.Descri: Ingenious mechanical contraptions that move and dance with intricate gears. These wondrous toys delight children and amaze all others in equal measure.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BronzeShipFittings.De: Precisely crafted bronze hardware for ships and boats. From cleats to hinges, each piece withstands the salt spray and endless sea.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CeremonialArmorLot.De: Ornate armor crafted for ceremony rather than battle. Polished to mirror brightness, perfect for royal guards and formal occasions.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DecorativeMithrilWork: Delicate true-silver worked into decorative pieces for halls and homes. Even the smallest accent gleams with otherworldly light.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.SteelWeaponsLot.Name: Weapons Cache
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.SteelWeaponsLot.Descr: A comprehensive armory of steel blades and points ready for export. Forged to Dwarven standards, trusted by warriors across Middle-earth.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.HealingSupplies.Name: Healer's Kit
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.HealingSupplies.Descr: Essential supplies and instruments for tending battle wounds. Crafted tools that help healers mend what war has broken.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DiamondJewerly.Name: Diamond Jewelry
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DiamondJewerly.Descri: Precious gems set in finest metal for the high and royal. Each piece proclaims the wealth and status of its wearer.
A personal strongbox that opens only for its rightful owner. Engraved with protective runes that guard its contents from thieves.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.GemSetFiligreeInlay.D: Precious stones set within intricate gold threadwork for master crafters. Transforms ordinary goods into treasures worthy of kings and lords.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.GoldJewerly.Name: Gold Jewelry
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.GoldJewerly.Descripti: Fine jewelry wrought from pure gold for those that love and covet such things. Each piece displays the skill that makes Dwarven goldwork legendary.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MithrilJewerly.Name: Mithril Jewelry
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.MithrilJewerly.Descri: True-silver worked into jewelry of unmatched beauty and lightness. More precious than gold, worn only by those with the ability to acquire such treasure.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.OrnateTablewear.Name: Ornate Tablewear
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.OrnateTablewear.Descr: Elaborate serving pieces and dining implements for grand feasts. Crafted to grace the tables of the most discerning hosts.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DwarvenHistories.Name: Dwarven Histories
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.DwarvenHistories.Desc: Beautifully illustrated manuscripts recounting the lost glory of the First and Second Ages. Knowledge preserved in gold leaf and careful script.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TravelingGear.Name: Traveler's Gear
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TravelingGear.Descrip: Sturdy leather packs and traveling equipment built to last long journeys. Essential gear for merchants and adventurers alike.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BrassButtons.Name: Brass Buttons
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BrassButtons.Descript: Polished brass buttons crafted to Hobbit preferences and sizing. No respectable vest is complete without proper Dwarven fasteners.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CopperBeltBuckles.Des: Ornate belt fasteners wrought from finest copper. Functional metalwork that serves as both utility and decoration.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.EliteArmor.Name: Prestige Armor
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.EliteArmor.Descriptio: Masterwork set of armor using the finest alloys and craftsmanship. While too expensive to outfit an entire army, these are often ordered for leaders and royal guards.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.EliteWeapons.Name: Prestige Weapons
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.EliteWeapons.Descript: Masterwork set of weapons using the finest alloys and craftsmanship. While too expensive to outfit an entire army, these are often ordered for leaders and royal guards.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TrebuchetParts.Name: Siege Components
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TrebuchetParts.Descri: Heavy iron fittings and mechanisms for building siege weapons. The backbone of any army's wall-breaking capability.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.WoodWorkingTools.Name: Carpenter's Kit
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.WoodWorkingTools.Desc: Precision tools for shaping timber and joining wood. No Carpenter's workshop is complete without dwarven-forged implements.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.PrecisionMeasurementT: Intricate devices for measuring land, angles, and distances. Essential for any grand construction or mapping endeavor.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.HorsemansIronwork.Des: Complete ironwork for horses and their riders including shoes, bits, and bridles. Everything needed to properly outfit horse and rider for farm work or travel.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.IronPotsAndPans.Name: Kitchen Ironware
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.IronPotsAndPans.Descr: Sturdy cooking vessels forged for daily use in hearth and kitchen. Built to last generations of family meals.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ArmyAle.Name: Campaign Ale Barrels
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ArmyAle.Description: Bulk barrels of strong brew designed to supply entire armies on campaign. Fortifies morale as much as the body.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.RohanAle.Name: Riddermark Brew Barrels
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.RohanAle.Description: Barrels of brew crafted to the tastes of the horse-lords. Strong ale for strong riders of the mark.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ShireAle.Name: Underhill Brew Barrels
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.ShireAle.Description: Gentle ales brewed to hobbit preferences for their inns and taverns. Light enough for second breakfast, hearty enough for elevenses.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.StarmetalCoins.Name: Starmetal Coins
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.StarmetalCoins.Descri: Rare coins minted from meteoric metal for distant realms. Their otherworldly gleam makes counterfeiting nearly impossible.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BronzeCoins.Name: Bronze Coins
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.BronzeCoins.Descripti: Standard bronze currency minted for foreign trade partners. Reliable coinage that holds its value across many lands.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CopperCoins.Name: Copper Coins
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CopperCoins.Descripti: Standard copper currency minted for distant lands. Reliable everyday coinage for markets and common transactions.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TinCoins.Name: Tin Coins
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.TinCoins.Description: Light tin currency minted for distant realms. Practical coinage for small purchases and everyday commerce.
KeysToEntries.Economy.TradeGoods.CeremonialWeapons.Des: Ornate weapons crafted for ceremony and display rather than battle. Polished steel that gleams in processions and formal occasions.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Lure.Description: In the Shire it's said a party is finished when someone, deep into many ales, comes back from the pantry wearing meat on their head. While funny, it can attract unwanted creatures.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Hat.Lure.Name: Meat Hat
KeysToEntries.Items.TrackingDevice.Name: Raven's Glimmer
KeysToEntries.Items.TrackingDevice.Description: A tiny, polished silver disc. Ravens are trained to see the flashes of light that glimmer off it, helping them track just about anything.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Mason.Name: Stonemason's Garb
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Mason.Description: Cosmetic, sturdy clothing built to withstand dust and stone chips. Practical wear for those who shape mountain stone into lasting works.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Trader.Name: Merchant's Attire
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Trader.Description: Cosmetic, well-made traveling clothes suitable for the road and marketplace. Garments that command respect in any trading hall.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Blacksmith.Name: Smith's Apron
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Blacksmith.Description: Cosmetic, heavy leather garments designed to protect against forge sparks and heat. Essential wear for any dwarf working hot iron.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Shopkeeper.Name: Keeper's Vest
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Shopkeeper.Description: Cosmetic, respectable clothing for those who tend shops and storehouses. Clean, practical garments that inspire customer confidence.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Tavern.Name: Innkeeper's Garb
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Tavern.Description: Cosmetic, stout clothing for those who serve ale and tend to travelers. Built to handle spills, smoke, and long working days.
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Cook.Name: Kitchen Apron
KeysToEntries.Armor.NPC.Outfit.Cook.Description: Cosmetic, practical garments for hearth and kitchen work. Designed to keep flour dust and cooking stains at bay.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Torso.Name: Gimli's Armor
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Torso.Description: A cosmetic armor torso in the style Lord Gimli of the Glittering Caves.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Gloves.Name: Gimli's Gloves
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Gloves.Description: Cosmetic gloves in the style Lord Gimli of the Glittering Caves.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Boots.Name: Gimli's Boots
KeysToEntries.Armor.Gimli.Boots.Description: Cosmetic boots in the style Lord Gimli of the Glittering Caves.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Barley.Name: Barley
KeysToEntries.Consumables.Barley.Description: While the Dwarves keep the more potent brew for themselves, they use this golden grain as a foundation for the more lightweight brew meant for distant lands.
KeysToEntries.Items.Fertilizer.Name: Soil Dressing
KeysToEntries.Items.Fertilizer.Description: Rich compost and manure for growing better crops. Turns poor soil into fertile earth for abundant harvests.
KeysToEntries.Items.SeaWax.Name: Sea Wax
KeysToEntries.Items.SeaWax.Description: Protective coating that shields metal from corrosion. Originally developed in coastal climates, the Dwarven army found it counteracts the corrosive humours of the Gundabad Orcs.
KeysToEntries.Items.WhaleTallow.Name: Whale Tallow
KeysToEntries.Items.WhaleTallow.Description: Rendered fat from great sea beasts, prized for its long-burning light. Essential for lamps in harbor towns and coastal settlements.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.OliveOil.Name: Southern Oil
KeysToEntries.Consumable.OliveOil.Description: Golden oil pressed from southern olive groves, prized for cooking fine meals. Adds richness to any dish worth serving
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Saffron.Name: Saffron
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Saffron.Description: Precious spice from the far eastern mountains. A pinch transforms simple fare into a feast fit for kings.
KeysToEntries.Item.NiphredilSeed.Name: Niphredil Seed
KeysToEntries.Item.NiphredilSeed.Description: Seeds of a rare white flower that once graced the gardens of Lothlórien. Few blooms are more beautiful or harder to cultivate.
KeysToEntries.Item.PumpkinSeed.Name: Pumpkin Seed
KeysToEntries.Item.PumpkinSeed.Description: Hardy seeds that grow into orange gourds perfect for autumn feasts. Essential for any settlement's winter stores.
KeysToEntries.Item.SweetrootSeed.Name: Sweetroot Seed
KeysToEntries.Item.SweetrootSeed.Description: Seeds for a hardy root vegetable that grows well in mountain soil. Provides sustenance through the lean months.
KeysToEntries.Item.ElanorSeed.Name: Elanor Seed
KeysToEntries.Item.ElanorSeed.Description: Seeds of the star-shaped winter flower that bloomed in Lothlórien. Brings Elven beauty to any garden fortunate enough to grow it.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Elanor.Name: Elanor Flower
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Elanor.Description: A star-shaped golden flower that blooms even in winter's cold. Once graced the mallorn-groves of the elven realm
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Niphredil.Name: Niphredil Flower
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Niphredil.Description: Delicate white flowers on slender stems, treasured for their pure beauty. A reminder of the grace that once was Lothlórien.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Pumpkin.Name: Pumpkin
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Pumpkin.Description: Large orange gourds perfect for hearty autumn meals. Essential for pies, soups, and winter celebrations.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Sweetroot.Name: Sweetroot
KeysToEntries.Consumable.Sweetroot.Description: A purple root vegetable with earthy sweetness. Grows well in rocky soil and stores through winter.
KeysToEntries.Consumable.DriedFish.Name: Salt-cured Fish
KeysToEntries.Consumable.DriedFish.Description: Dried and preserved fish from western waters, prepared for long keeping. Essential rations for any journey beyond the coasts and peaks.
KeysToEntries.Item.Wool.Name: Northern Wool
KeysToEntries.Item.Wool.Description: Thick fleece from the hardy flocks that graze the northern lands of Arnor and the Shire. Prized for its warmth and softness, essential for clothing in the cooler climates of northern Middle-earth.
KeysToEntries.Item.Silk.Name: Elven Silk
KeysToEntries.Item.Silk.Description: Lustrous fabric woven with timeless Elven skill. Its shimmer catches light like starfire, the finest cloth in all Middle-earth.
KeysToEntries.Ore.Marble.Name: Coastal Marble
KeysToEntries.Ore.Marble.Description: White stone quarried from seaside cliffs and mountain faces. Prized by builders for its beauty and lasting strength.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Orcbane.Torso.Name: Expeditioner's Armor
KeysToEntries.Armor.Orcbane.Torso.Description: Plate armor sealed with Sea Wax as worn by soldiers in the combined army of Erebor and The Iron Hills. The wax was a needed battlefield invention to combat the corrosive arrows of the Gundabad Orcs.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Orcbane.Boots.Name: Expeditioner's Boots
KeysToEntries.Armor.Orcbane.Boots.Description: Heavy Durinul iron boots covered in Sea Wax to counteract the corrosive poison of Gundabad.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Boots.Name: Starlight SlippersCUT
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Boots.Description: Elven footwear woven with Ithildin thread that gleams softly in darkness. A gift of Rivendell's craft to aid Dwarven miners in the deepest tunnels of Khazad-dûm.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Helmet.Name: Starlight CowlCUT
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Helmet.Description: A protective head covering embedded with mithril-spun Ithildin that casts starlight around the wearer's face. Born from the union of Rivendell wisdom and Dwarven metalcraft.
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Torso.Name: Starlight Mail CUT
KeysToEntries.Armor.Starlight.Torso.Description: Fine chainmail interlaced with Ithildin, granting the wearer a gentle luminance. Forged through ancient Elven techniques shared by Rivendell.
KeysToEntries.Item.Shell.Name: Shell
KeysToEntries.Item.Shell.Description: Polished shells gathered from western shores. Used to accent stonework and bring the beauty of the sea inland.
KeysToEntries.Item.AleCask.Name: Bound Barrels
KeysToEntries.Item.AleCask.Description: Empty wooden barrels crafted for shipping ale to distant markets. Built to keep precious brew fresh during long journeys. Check for Hobbits before filling.

KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.MeatHat.Descriptio: Crafting recipe for a hat made of meat. Used in the Shire at parties. While funny it can attract unwanted creatures.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Orcbane.Armor.Tors: Crafting recipe for anti-corrosive armor used in the Siege of Gundabad.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Orcbane.Armor.Boot: Crafting recipe for anti-corrosive boots used in the Siege of Gundabad.

KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Starlight.Armor.He: Crafting recipe from Rivendell smiths for a head covering that softly glows with Ithildin.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Starlight.Armor.To: Crafting recipe from Rivendell smiths for a shoes that softly glows with Ithildin.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Starlight.Armor.Bo: Crafting recipe from Rivendell smiths for armor that softly glows with Ithildin.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.Starlight.Weapon.D: The Dwarves of the Red Mountains, finding it strange that the Company only fights with Mauls and Mattocks, offer to share this crafting recipe for a legendary two-handed battlehammer.

KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.SeaWax.Name: Sea Wax Recipe
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.SeaWax.Description: Recipe to craft a protective coating that shields armor from corrosion.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.WayfarersPack.Name: Delver's Pack Recipe
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.WayfarersPack.Desc: Crafing recupe for a large pack with a unique look. Gives the maximum inventory space.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.ShireDecoration.De: Building plans for a display of hanging pots and pans.
KeysToEntries.Economy.Recipe.Bundle.BlueMountainDecora: Building plans for a decorative split geode in the style found in the Blue Mountains.

KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal1.Name: Sweetroot Morning Cakes
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal1.Description: Grate sweetroot into small breakfast cakes made with milled oats and beaten egg. Pan-fry in olive oil until golden brown and crispy outside, fluffy within.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal2.Name: Golden Saffron Stew
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal2.Description: Simmer mountain potatoes and beans in rich broth, then stir in precious saffron and diced sweetroot until golden. The sweetroot adds earthy sweetness while saffron gives this hearty stew its royal color.
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal3.Name: Roasted Glazed Pumpkin
KeysToEntries.Consumables.DurinFolk.Meal3.Description: Cut pumpkin into thick wedges, brush with olive oil and roast until tender. Glaze with cave honey and sprinkle with thyme seed. The olive oil crisps the edges while honey caramelizes into a golden crust.

KeysToEntries.Armor.Krampus.Torso.Name: Kabrûn Costume
KeysToEntries.Armor.Krampus.Torso.Description: Festive Deep-night outfit of tattered leather wrapped in chains and hung with small iron bells. Traditional costume for those portraying the Bell-dragger during the <Inventory.Regular.White>Khufur-nagim-ul</> celebration.

Item.MintSeed.Description.Context: Plant in a farm to grow Mint. Seeds can be found in small pots in residences and inside greenhouses.

Item.OilyPeatMoss.Description.Context: A plant found in ch. 4. Found near water in unlit areas

Item.PreciousGem.Amethyst.Description.Context: Used to engrave cold rune (slows enemies + makes them vulnerable to fire rune attacks). Also Used to craft Belegost gear. Found in "darkest deeps" in the grottos

Item.PreciousGem.Anorin.Description.Context: Used to engrave Hunter rune (Can refund stamina ). Also Used to craft various utility gear, most of which will be held for DLC. Found in "darkest deeps" in the Delsolation

Item.PreciousGem.BlackDiamond.Descriptio.Context: Used to build/repair major structures in Moria (crystal descent contraption, eastern stairs, etc.). Required to build/repair maps stones for fast travel. Required to craft many higher level pickaxes and hammers.Generally found in orc camp chests, orc town chests, and all darkest deeps

Item.PreciousGem.Diamond.Description.Context: Used to engrave anti-dragon rune (Extra damage against dragons). Also Used to craft the dragon spear. Found in "darkest deeps" in the Delsolation

Item.PreciousGem.Ruby.Description.Context: Used to engrave fire rune (burn damage over time + makes them vulnerable to cold rune attacks). Also Used to craft First Age gear. Found in "darkest deeps" in the grottos

Item.PreciousGem.Sapphire.Description.Context: Used to engrave anti-orc rune (Extra damage against orcs + glows when orcs are near). Found in "darkest deeps" in the grottos. May be found in western mine orc camp chests

Item.PreciousGem.Topaz.Description.Context: Used to engrave thunder rune (Small damage boost + big increase to knockback on charged attack). Also Used to craft Nogrod gear. Found in "darkest deeps" in the grottos

Item.RopeLadder.Description.Context: Build ropes to easily descend big drops. Requireds natural fibers (spiders in mines, rope vines in grottos and beyond) to make

Item.SemiPreciousGem.Amber.Description.Context: Used for armor tinting. Found in coal veins

Item.SemiPreciousGem.Citrine.Description.Context: Used for armor tinting. Found in iron veins in ch. 2

Item.WhiteBeanSeed.Description.Context: Plant in a farm to grow white bean. Seeds can be found in small pots in residences and inside greenhouses.

Items.Adamant.Description.Context: The strongest rock material in the game. Gold and Mithril are found in Adamant. Used for Building large structures, fortress base buildings, and eventually the bridge of Khazad-Dum. Requires ironwood pickaxe to mine. Foundthroughout moria

Items.AltarFigurine.Description.Context: Generic description for all altar figurine items

Items.AncientWood.Description.Context: A stong wood found in from the strange mushroom growths in the Lower deeps. Involved in building many advanced crafting buildings and advanced buildings.

Items.Biofuel.Description.Context: A fuel source made from various organic materials in the world of moria

Items.BoltsOfCloth.Description.Context: Crafting material used for higher level armor (primarily belegost). Made at the fabric station from many cloth scraps

Items.Bone.Description.Context: Crafting ingredient for Orc Medicine. Potentially future DLC craftables. Will be dropped from boney armor worn by Ghash orcs. Possibly dropped by deep orcs as well

Items.BronzeIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Primarily Elven items, the mattock, and some crafting buildings. Made from Tin and Copper

Items.Chitin.Description.Context: Crafting ingredient for Brews. Primarily defense brew and orc medicine, though this list may expand. Dropped by Moths

Items.ChiveSeeds.Description.Context: Seed for growing chives at a farm. Seeds can be found in small pots in residences and inside greenhouses.

Items.ClothScraps.Description.Context: Basic crafting material for early gear. Eventually can be combined into bolts of cloth at the fabric station to help make better armors. Can be found in bulk in teh many residences of Moria buildings. Also collected from various remains in the streets.

Items.Coin.Description.Context: Gold coins found around moria. Can be assembled in a treasure pile that gives players a buff (and is also just cool to look at) . Coins are generally found inside dwarven residencese. They are also hoarded by orcs/trolls in their treasure chests/piles

Items.Feathers.Description.Context: Crafting equipment for making better arrows. Found throughout the game in cave nests up above the player

Items.FineCloth.Description.Context: Crafting material for highest level armors. Requires Spindle wheel to make

Items.FineLeather.Description.Context: Crafting material for highest level armors. Requires upgraded workbench and is made from salt, hide, and resin

Items.Fur.Description.Context: Dropped by furry animals and used to craft anti-cold armor. Possibly being held for DLC

Items.GoldCoins.Description.Context: Gold coins that can be used to make a treasure pile. Found throughout moria homes. Horded by orcs and trolls

Items.GoldIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Made from gold ore. Used for some constructions and also for gold coins

Items.Granite.Description.Context: Sronger building material than stone. Mined from various voxels around moria. Holds Silver, resin, salt, and precious gem ores. Used to make various crafting buildings + advanced base architecture. Requires first age pickaxe to mine. Found throughout moria but first collected in lower deeps

Items.GundabadScrap.Description.Context: Corrupted gundabad metal carried by Gundabad orcs

Items.GunMetalIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Made from silver, tin, and copper. Key ingredient in belegost equipment and a few other key tools/constructions

Items.HeavyCarryWrapper.DisplayName.Context: shows up in the item added popup when picking up something heavy

Items.Hide.Description.Context: Crafting material for mid level weapons armor.Collected from hunting deer and goats. Deer can be found in the elven quarter (and surrounding area) and Dwarrodelf. Goats are in the lower deeps

Items.HideScraps.Description.Context: Crafting material found on small animals and wolves. Used to craftin first round of weapons and armor

Items.IronIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Earliest ingot in the game, used for iron eqiupment.

Items.Ironwood.Description.Context: Will primarily be found in Dwarrodelf from breaking ironwood furniture and fixtures. Also from pallets in various interiors. Ironwood was only imported, so initially players can only scavenge it

Items.Items.Stone.Name.Context: A piece of stone useful for building structures

Items.IthildinIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Likely being held for DLC content.

Items.KhazadSteelIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Made from gold and other metals to make an alloy. Key ingredient for khazad equipment

Items.Leather.Description.Context: Crafting material for first age and belegost equipment. Made from hide and salt

Items.Memorial.Description.Context: Collected from dwarf remains CBPs. Combine to make a large base memorial

Items.Memorial.Name.Context: A memorial stone is given to the players after interacting with a long deceased Dwarf. This is the text that appears when viewing the item in the inventory.

Items.MithrilIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Key ingredient for mithril equipment.

Items.NaturalFiber.Description.Context: Used to make rope ladders. This material is an abstract material that you get from collecting spider silk and rope vines. Spiders start appearing in the mines. Rope vines start appearing in the deeps

Items.NogrodSteelIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Made from Moonstone, Sunstone, and Iron. Key ingredient for Nogrod equipment.

Items.PreciousGem.Emerald.Description.Context: Used to make Hunters rune and Khazad items. Found in "darkest deeps" in the Delsolation

Items.PurifiedDarkIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Key ingredient for Durin armor and items. Made from purified gundabad slag,

Items.QualityWood.Description.Context: Dropped from trees in the elven quarter. Will also drop from wooden scaffolding structures in the mines. Required for erebor weapons, steel pickaxe, and some forward camp constructions

Items.QuietMoss.Description.Context: Crafting ingredient used to make various alchemical brews with powerful effects. Found in lower deeps in unlit areas near water

Items.RemedyIngredient.Name.Context: The world "abahk" is a khuzdul word meaning "an item that changes you". So only the first word should be translated

Items.RopeVines.Description.Context: A flora found throughout moria. Collected to get natural fibers

Items.Scales.Description.Context: Crafting ingrdient that comes from drakes and fell beasts. Used for alchemical brews with various effects.

Items.ScrapMetal.Description.Context: Basic crafting ingrdient used to make early weapons and to repair weapons/armor. Represents any ruined metal object found in Moria

Items.SilverIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Key ingredient to First age equipement.

Items.SpiderSilk.Description.Context: Collected from defeated spiders and spider nests. Collected into the inventory as natural fibers

Items.StarAlloyIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Key ingredient to Durin armor and items

Items.StatueCrown.Description.Context: Required repair piece for the durin statue in the troll king boss area

Items.SteelIngot.Description.Context: Metal ingot for crafting things. Key for erebor equipment and a few key tools

Items.Stone.Description.Context: Basic constuction material found throughout moria. Used to build early crafting stations and base constructions. Mined from dirt plugs and basic voxels that hold iron, copper, tin, and coal

Ores.Coal.Description.Context: Raw ore used as fuel, crafts steel, and helps craft many other ingots. Abundant throughout moria but first appears in westgate

Ores.CopperOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafts copper ingots. First found in the mines

Ores.GoldOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafts gold ingots. Found in small quantities throughout Moria, but starts appearing more abbundantly in Dwarrodelf and beyond. Requires an Ironwood pickaxe to mine.

Ores.IronOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafts iron ingots. Foundthroughout Moria, but is especially plentiful in the western zones.

Ores.MithrilOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafs mithril ingots. Found in Mithril town and the Mithril deeps spread through the angry caverns

Ores.MoonStone.Description.Context: Ore that can be used to craft various light sources. Also required for elven armor. First discovered in the crystal descent in various breakable rocks. Will exist throughout the game from that point on.

Ores.Resin.Description.Context: A stronger fuel than coal (fuels crafting stations for longer). Also used as an occasional crafting material. Found primarily in the Lower deeps. Requires a first age pickaxe to mine.

Ores.Salt.Description.Context: Mineable food ingredient used for many recipes. Found primarily in the lower deeps. Requires a first age pickaxe to mine.

Ores.SilverOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafts silver ingots. Also combines with tin and copper to make belegost bronze. Found throughout moria in small quantities, but is plentiful in the deeps. Requires a first age pickaxe to mine.

Ores.StarMetalOre.Description.Context: Ore that crafts star metal ingots. Found in the Angry Caverns

Ores.SunStone.Description.Context: Used to engrave light rune (deals extra damage to shadow enemies, pushes back shadow like durin's axe). Used to construct grow lamps. Used to craft Royal Star Metal Armor. Found in "darkest deeps" in the Delsolation and in the angry caverns

Ores.TinOre.Description.Context: Ore that combines with copper to make various forms of bronze ingots. First found in the mines, though will re-appear throughout the world.

Runes.AnitDragon.Description.Context: Increases damage against dragon enemies and makes your weapon glow when they are near.

Runes.AntiOrc.Description.Context: Makes weapons glow when orcs are near + weapons do more damage against orcs

Runes.AntiShadow.Description.Context: Makes weapon push away shadow like durin's axe. Deals extra damage to ghash orcs and any other shadow enemy

Runes.Cold.Description.Context: Deals extra damage to any enemy vulnerable to cold. Charged attack can slow enemies and make them extra vlunerable to fire rune attacks.

Runes.DamageBoost.Description.Context: Simple rune that simply adds damage to all weapons.

Runes.Fire.Description.Context: Deals extra damage to any enemy vulnerable to fire. Charged attacks "burn enemies" by dealing damage over time and make them extra vulnerable to cold rune attacks.

Runes.Hunters.Description.Context: Deals extra damage to hunting fauna and wargs/wolves. completing a combo on an enemy can restore a pip of stamina

Runes.Ironwood.Description.Context: Makes it possible for players to extract ironwood from any wood breakable on a tunable chance

Runes.Thunder.Description.Context: Applies across the board damage increase. Charged attacks deal extra strong knockback

Tools.CrystalTorch.Description.Context: An epic item torch made from moonstone that never goes out

Tools.DurinsAxe.PickHammer.Description.Context: Durins Axe! OMG it was a pickaxe the whole time! This pickaxe mines most minerals quickly (speed only beaten by the 2h pickaxe). More importantly it repels shadow vents from the player and can break shadow seals on doors.

Tools.Hammer.Gunmetal.Description.Context: Gunmetal hammer is required to repair the eastern stairs and statues in 4-1 and beyond. It will also let the player repair more structures found in the world and will repair structures faster than the iron or steel hammer.

Tools.Hammer.Restoration.Iron.Descriptio.Context: This hammer unlocks bassic repair of structures and the ability to repair statues found in westgate.

Tools.Hammer.Restoration.Starmetal.Descr.Context: This hammer can reapir any structgure and does it faster than preceding hammers. Also unlocks the ornate base constructions

Tools.Hammer.Restoration.Steel.Descripti.Context: This hammer is needed to repair statues in the elven quarter and in the mines. Also unlocks building forward camp structures.

Tools.MoonStoneFlare.Description.Context: Made of moonstone. Can be thrown as a temporary lightsource. Will likely be dropped by various light fixtures around moria, which we've tentatively said our made from moonstone

Tools.Pickaxe.2H.Description.Context: A 2 handed epic item pickaxe. Can mine any voxel in the game and does it faster (and with a larger carve size_ than any other pickaxe

Tools.Pickaxe.Basic.Description.Context: Makeshift pickaxe players start the game with. Can mine dirt plugs, stone, and early early ores but does it slowly and with poor durrability.

Tools.Pickaxe.FirstAge.Description.Context: 2nd pickaxe upgrade. Can mine granite voxels and associated ores (silver, resin, salt, lower deeps precious gems). Mines faster than preceeding pickaxes

Tools.Pickaxe.Ironwood.Description.Context: 3rd Picaxe upgrade  required to mine adamant and ore set in adamant voxels (primarily gold and desolation precious gems). Mines faster than preceeding pickaxes.

Tools.Pickaxe.Magic.Name.Context: Dev item. not a player facing string

Tools.Pickaxe.Steel.Description.Context: First major pickaxe upgrade. Mines things faster than makeshift with better durrability. Also can mine through compacted dirt plugs.

Tools.ThrowTorch.Description.Context: Made of wood and coal. Can be thrown as a temporary lightsource

Tools.Torch.Description.Context: basic hand torch that lights the area around you. Burns out over time.
